<!-- pr-reviewer: b26532d8bc7e69038dfe11f90755d93abb6dfa9c -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The change meets the requirements of #1783. The shared planner adds kernel to the release build and selects each kernel test binary that can contain ignored tests. The new test checks kernel coverage without use of the heavy-crate list as its source. The decision record explains the choice.

Local checks in `.claude/worktrees/review-1835`:
- Trial merge with upstream/main at db091cb38163f3713ce44918ea973855cd0960ad: already up to date. No conflicts.
- `cargo test -p xtask --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 137 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Quick plan with `--base upstream/main --dry-run`: selects the xtask unit tests.
- Release plan with `--dry-run`: passed, 182 steps. Kernel has a release build and separate heavy test steps, including agreement and mesh_deviation_bench.

Requested changes: none.

This PR changes test planning only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision and gouge checks. No UI files or goldens change. No mutation was run, and no source file was changed during this review. Actual heavy kernel tests and the full release gate were not run. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
